investigated_problem: Instance segmentation under dense mushrooms; potential value of depth
baseline: YOLOv8-N segmentation; Mask R-CNN as paper reference
reported_results: Paper Table 2: YOLOv8-N segmentation AP 0.712 at image size 640; AP 0.846 at 1280; Mask R-CNN ResNet-50 RGB seg AP 0.866 at 1280.
author_stated_limitations: RGB-D Mask R-CNN did not improve over RGB in authors’ direct four-channel setup (RGB 0.866 vs RGB-D 0.846 segmentation AP at 1280).
independently_observed_limitations: V2 notebook: extreme BB/WB imbalance; unclear scene independence; non-identical split and release; all subject to reviewer confirmation.
proposed_hypothesis: A more careful depth-fusion strategy might improve boundary quality or crowded-instance segmentation versus RGB-only, holding split and compute fixed.
supporting_evidence: Original paper pp. 10-12; uploaded notebook EDA 2026-10-30
contradictory_evidence: Paper direct four-channel RGB-D result was worse; added depth is not inherently beneficial.
